source.working_tree_note: Story 6.3's own artifacts (tests/release-smoke.test.mjs, release notes, this record, spec, evidence entries) are uncommitted on top of the recorded commit; the package tree digests below are the binding artifact identity and are reproducible from the tree at any time (deterministic-materialization row in tests/release-smoke.test.mjs).

artifacts.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 folded over every regular file in package-relative path-sorted order: for each file, update with hex(sha256(relative_path)) + '\n' + hex(sha256(file_bytes)) + '\n'; the final hex digest is the tree digest (tests/release-smoke.test.mjs, treeDigest). No metadata (mtimes, modes, inodes) enters the digest.
